title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Urges Industry Limits on AI Development
description: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki called in a Sunday post for industrywide standards that would set thresholds for advanced AI development. The comments add to a growing debate over voluntary limits among frontier labs as competition intensifies.

title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
description: Anthropic's record $93.5 billion Nasdaq listing landed in the middle of tech's steepest weekly selloff since 2020. Shares that opened at $111.50 on Thursday closed Friday at $88.91, as investors pulled back from AI-exposed stocks.

title: Strong Earnings Prove No Match for the Crumbling AI Trade
description: Bloomberg reports that solid corporate earnings failed to stem a broad retreat from AI-linked equities last week. The piece examines how investor sentiment around AI infrastructure spending has shifted despite strong fundamentals.

title: Goldman Sachs admits the 'AI unwind' has spiraled into something more dangerous — and it's watching for 3 signs of bottom
description: Goldman Sachs strategists say the unwinding of crowded AI trades has broadened into a wider S&P 500 correction. The bank outlines three conditions, including hedge fund positioning, it is monitoring for signs the selloff has bottomed.

title: China’s $1.7 Trillion AI Rout Turns Hot Trade Into Losing Bet
description: Stocks on three tech-focused Chinese indexes have lost a combined $1.7 trillion in market value since the end of June. The rout has prompted regulators in China, Taiwan and South Korea to roll out market-support measures, including easier margin requirements.

title: China Plans to Strengthen AI Token Standards in Computing Push
description: China's National Data Administration will improve standards for measuring and billing AI tokens and for assessing their quality. The move is part of a wider government push to build out and commercialize national computing capacity.

title: Microsoft Says Copilot Is Beating Anthropic, OpenAI on Price
description: Microsoft argued at Ignite that its first-party MAI models let Copilot undercut Anthropic and OpenAI on cost for enterprise workloads. Some of the claimed pricing advantages reflect promotional discounts, and performance claims rest on selected benchmarks.

title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
description: GitHub expanded Copilot Fusion, its automatic model-routing option, to more surfaces and added new models to the pool. The changelog also publishes GitHub's own benchmark results for the feature, which have not been independently verified.

title: Welcome to the singularity
description: Fortune examines claims from tech leaders including Elon Musk, Sam Altman and Stripe's founders that AI agents are ushering in a period of rapid, compounding change. The essay weighs what an agent-driven economy could mean for how businesses operate.
